meta.title: AeroVibe — Drone spots, flight plans, and community
meta.description: Discover real spots, plan flights, and build community. AeroVibe combines map-first discovery, optimized media, hangar, and ranking into a fast experience.

hero.title: Land on real spots. Fly with confidence.
hero.subtitle: AeroVibe is the hub to discover, create, and plan drone spots with real location, optimized media, and Pro tools.
hero.note: iOS and Android. Private beta in progress.

features.title: Everything you need, no noise
features.subtitle: Built for pilots: fast, clear, and focused on what matters.

cards.map_body: Nearby spots, pins, and detail. When creating, pick a point on the map (or use GPS).
cards.media_body: Thumbnails, compression, and smooth playback for photo and video.
cards.flight_body: Schedule flights, invite copilots, and get reminders.
cards.ranking_body: Points for real activity. Badges that evolve with your progress.
cards.hangar_body: Your drones, stats, and slots based on your plan.
cards.moderation_body: Tools to keep the community safe and the signal clean.

about.title: About us
about.p1: AeroVibe started where it always starts: backpack on, batteries at 12%, wind changing every five minutes, and the same group chat thread: “where do we fly today without wasting time?”.
about.p2: We’re a small (and slightly obsessive) team building a community with more signal and less noise: real spots, media that loads fast, stable profiles, and tools that help you decide before takeoff.
about.p3: If you’ve ever driven out just to find the spot wasn’t what it looked like, or you want to share a great location without it getting buried, you’re in the right place. We’re building AeroVibe with real pilot feedback — for everyday use.

faq.title: FAQs
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to get started without friction.

items.a: AeroVibe is a platform to discover, create, and plan drone spots with real location, optimized media, and tools to fly with more context.

items.q: Do I need an account to use AeroVibe?
items.a: You can browse public content without an account. To interact (create spots, comment, favorites, flight plans) you need to sign in.
The product is designed to be collaborative: spots are meant to be public and useful to the community. Additional controls may arrive later.
More hangar slots, extended forecast, higher limits, and early access to premium features. Details may evolve as the product grows.

items.q: Does AeroVibe track my location in the background?
items.a: No. We only use location when you allow it and when you need it (for example, to create spots or show nearby content).

items.q: How do I report content or get help?
items.a: We’re adding moderation and reporting tools. For support, email support@aerovibe.app.
